trigger: an author follows the rule's blanket encoding="utf-8" fix for a Python or meson child that prints non-ASCII on the Windows leg
summary: Rule asserts Node/rebar3/meson/git all write UTF-8 and prescribes encoding="utf-8" universally. A Python child (meson included: mesonmain.py:239-240 keeps the locale code page) writes cp1252 to a pipe on Windows (Shulgi: e9 0d 0a), so the advice fails it. Also, on Windows run()/communicate() do not raise: the reader-thread UnicodeDecodeError goes to threading.excepthook and run() returns stdout=None with the original returncode, so the failure can be silent (verified on Shulgi). Message should say: match the child's real encoding (utf-8 for Node/git; PYTHONUTF8=1 in env or errors="replace" for Python/meson children) and state the stdout=None failure mode.
classification_rationale: The rule text states something false (meson writes UTF-8) and prescribes an action that fails silently for one child class. I4 base HIGH, E7 (advisory warn rule, author-controlled input) caps at MEDIUM.

trigger: reader on a non-Western Windows locale or Python >= 3.15
summary: "On Windows that is cp1252": it is the ANSI code page (cp1252 on Western locales only), and UTF-8 mode (default from Python 3.15, PEP 686; off on Shulgi 3.14) changes it. Suggested: "the ANSI code page (cp1252 on Western locales), unless UTF-8 mode is on (the default from Python 3.15)". Five unmapped bytes and strict default verified correct; fire-on-any-OS judged the right design.
classification_rationale: Version/locale scoping of a true statement.

trigger: a developer on Clang 18 / Apple Clang 15-16 / MSVC reads the comment and concludes the pattern is safe there
summary: Comment names only GCC < 15; P2718R0 is also absent in Clang <= 18 (landed in 19), Apple Clang 15/16, and (unverified) MSVC. __cpp_range_based_for is 201603 on GCC 14 vs 202211 on GCC 15 / Apple clang 21 / LLVM 23 (verified). Raised independently in the same wave by cpp-expert (cppx-1) and cross-platform (F3). Suggested: "on compilers without P2718R0 (__cpp_range_based_for < 202211L: GCC <= 14, Clang <= 18, MSVC)".
classification_rationale: Comment is true but incomplete in a way that can mislead.
